I’m in on 12 tons if all five explicitly agree, and 6 each if next month starts at 80. Otherwise, I’ll choose 10 unless we unanimously agree on another allocation.

Emma’s comparison supports trying this, though the long-run plan matters more than just the next two months. Repeating the proposed rule would average 10.8 tons per person per month, assuming everyone complies—better than a steady 10, while keeping us above the collapse threshold.

Let’s confirm the actual stock before each month’s agreement and address any excess catches without starting a race to empty the lake. John, do you agree to those limits?
